title: God's Got Your Back
paragraphs: §Comfort in Suffering

Hey, it's Paul, on a special mission from Jesus himself, all part of God's master plan. I'm writing this to all the believers in Corinth and the whole Achaia area. Hope you're getting all the awesome perks from God our Father and our main man, Jesus. My bro Timothy is here with me, and he says 'sup.

Shout-out to the God and Father of our Lord, Jesus Christ! He's the Father of mercy and the God of all comfort. When we're going through tough times, he's right there with us. And then, when we see someone else struggling, we can help them out, just like God helped us. Following Jesus can be tough, for sure, but the comfort he gives us is way better. It's like an amazing change for your soul.

When we have a hard time, it's actually for your benefit, so you can be saved. And when we're doing good, that's for you too, to keep you going and not give up. Your struggles are our struggles. When we see you guys sticking it out through the hard times, just like you enjoy the good times, we know you're gonna be alright. No doubt.

We gotta tell you, it was rough for us in Asia. We seriously thought we were done for, like we were on death row. But it turned out to be a good thing. Instead of relying on ourselves, we had to put all our trust in God. And since he's the one who can raise the dead, that's a pretty solid plan. He saved us from what looked like certain doom, and he'll do it again, as many times as we need. And you guys were a part of it too, with your prayers. We don't want you to forget that. We can just imagine you all, cheering for us and thanking God for getting us through it. Your prayers were a huge part of our rescue mission.

Now that we're through the worst of it, we're glad to say we came out with our faith and integrity intact. We can look you in the eye and be proud. But it wasn't because of anything we did. It was God who kept us on track. Don't try to read between the lines in this letter. We're telling you the straight-up truth. We hope you can see the whole picture now, not just bits and pieces. We want you to be as proud of us as we are of you when we all stand before Jesus.

I was so sure you guys would be cool with it, I was planning to visit you twice. Once on my way to Macedonia, and then again on my way back. We could've had a big send-off party before I went to Judea. That was the plan, anyway.

So now you're gonna say I'm a flip-flopper because things changed? You think I say one thing and do another? Nah, that's not me. I try to be as real as God is. We didn't give you a half-hearted 'yes' and then a 'whatever' 'no'. When Silas, Timothy, and I told you about Jesus, was there any doubt? It was a solid 'yes'!

Everything God has ever promised is a 'yes' in Jesus. That's what we preach, and that's what we pray. It's God's 'yes' and our 'yes' all together. God makes us strong in Christ and puts his 'yes' inside of us. He's put his Spirit in us as a down payment on everything he's promised to do.
So, you wanna know the real reason I didn't come to Corinth? I swear to God, it was to spare you any more drama. I was trying to be cool, not a bully.
We're not trying to be your bosses and tell you how to live your faith. We're in this with you, and we're excited to see what God does. We know you've got your own faith, and that's what matters.

title: No Drama, Just Love
paragraphs: §Paul Changes Plans

Hey, so I decided not to roll through again and make things awkward for everyone. Like, if I showed up and it was all tense, how could you guys even make me feel better? That's why I sent that letter instead of just showing up. I didn't want to have a bummer of a time with the very people I was hoping would hype me up. I was sure that what was good for me was good for you. Honestly, writing that letter was rough. More tears than ink, for real. But I wasn't trying to start drama. I wrote it so you'd know how much I've got your backs. For real, it's all love.

About the guy who started all this mess... you know who I'm talking about. He didn't just hurt me, he hurt pretty much all of you. So I'm not gonna go all hard on him. The punishment you guys decided on is enough. It's time to forgive him and help him get back up. If you just keep piling on the guilt, you're gonna crush him. My advice? Show him some love.

My letter wasn't about getting revenge on the guy. It was about you guys stepping up and taking care of our crew. So if you forgive him, I forgive him. I'm not holding any grudges. I'm on your team with this forgiveness thing, and Christ is with us, showing us the way. We don't want to give the enemy an opening to cause more trouble. We're not clueless, we know his tricks.

When I got to Troas to spread the word about Jesus, it was wide open. God had opened the door for me. But when I didn't see my boy Titus there with an update on you guys, I couldn't chill. I was worried about you, so I bounced and went to Macedonia to find him and get some good news. And I did, thank God!

In Jesus, God leads us in a never-ending victory parade. Through us, he flexes his power and everyone can smell the sweet scent of knowing him. To those being saved, we smell like life. To those who are lost, we probably stink like a dead body. That's a huge responsibility. Who's good enough for that? Nobody, but at least we're not watering down God's word and selling it on the street. We're real with you. We're standing in front of God when we speak, and we say it like it is.

title: The Ultimate Transformation
paragraphs: §Forgiveness

Hey, are we trying to flex on you? Like we're bragging about how awesome we are? Nah, that's not it at all. We don't need some fancy recommendation letter to prove we're legit. You guys are our living proof. Your lives are like an open book that anyone can read, and Christ himself is the author. He didn't write on paper, but on your hearts with the Spirit of God. That's the real deal.

For real, we're super confident about this. You are our letter of recommendation, written by Christ for God. We could never write something like that about ourselves. Only God can do that. He's the one who gave us the hookup to this new way of life. It's not some boring rulebook that kills your vibe. It's a spiritual upgrade, a total life-changer.

The old way, the law of Moses, was like the OG rules. When Moses brought down the stone tablets, his face had an incredible glow. It was so bright that people couldn't even look at him. But that was just a temporary glow. The new way, the way of the Spirit, is a permanent, next-level change. If the old way was about getting called out for your mistakes, the new way is about getting a thumbs-up from God. The old way was like a temporary fix, but this new way is the real MVP, and it's here to stay.

Because we have this awesome hope, we're not holding anything back. We're not like Moses who had to hide his fading glory. We're putting it all out there. The people back then were clueless. They couldn't see that the old way was losing its power. Even now, when they read the old rules, it's like they're wearing a blindfold. Only Christ can take off the blindfold and show them that the old way is obsolete.

But whenever someone turns to God, He takes away the blindfold and they can see Him face-to-face. They realize that God is not some distant, angry guy, but a living, personal God. And when you're in His presence, the old rules don't matter anymore. We're free! There's nothing between us and God. Our faces are shining with His glory. We're going through a powerful shift, becoming more and more like Jesus as God works in our lives.

title: Seriously, We're Legit
paragraphs: §The New Covenant

Hey, so God's been super generous and let us in on his master plan. So, no way are we just gonna quit when things get a little rough. We're not about being fake or playing games. We don't do sneaky stuff behind the scenes, and we're not twisting God's words to make ourselves look good. Nah, we're all about keeping it 100. Everything we do is out in the open for everyone to see, so you can see for yourself that we're legit in God's eyes.

If our message seems confusing, it's not 'cause we're hiding anything. It's 'cause some people are just looking in the wrong direction and aren't even trying to get it. They're all about the trendy "god of darkness," thinking he'll give them whatever they want without having to believe in something real. They're totally blind to the awesome light of the message about Jesus, who's like the ultimate selfie of God.

Just to be clear, this whole thing isn't about us. We're here to tell you about Jesus, the real MVP. We're just the delivery guys, the messengers sent by Jesus for you. It all started when God was like, "Let there be light!" and BAM, our lives lit up when we finally got who God was by looking at Jesus. It was a life-changing moment.

If you only look at us, you might miss the main event. We're just ordinary guys, like clay pots holding this amazing treasure. That's so nobody gets it twisted and thinks we're the ones with the power. And let's be real, there's no chance of that. We get roughed up and surrounded by problems, but we don't give up. We get confused, but we know God's got the answers. We've been scared out of our minds, but God never ghosted us. We get knocked down, but we're not out. They're doing the same stuff to us that they did to Jesus—roasting us, trying to cancel us—but the same power that raised Jesus is alive in us. We're constantly in danger for Jesus, which just makes his life shine even brighter through us. So while we're going through it, you're getting the benefits.

We're not keeping this a secret. Just like the guy in the Psalms who said, "I believed it, so I said it," we're shouting what we believe from the rooftops. And we believe that the same God who brought Jesus back to life will do the same for us, and we'll all be together. Everything that happens is for your benefit and for God's glory. More grace, more people, more praise!

So, we're not giving up. No way! Even though it looks like we're falling apart on the outside, on the inside, God is giving us an incredible renewal every single day. These tough times are nothing compared to the epic party that's waiting for us. There's so much more going on than what you can see. The stuff we see now is temporary, but the stuff we can't see is forever.

title: Level Up Your Life
paragraphs: §Ambassadors for Christ

Hey, so check it. We know that our bodies are basically like old, beat-up tents. One day, we're gonna pack 'em up and trade 'em in for brand-new resurrection bodies in heaven. These aren't some cheap, handmade things; they're custom-built by God himself, and we'll never have to move again. It's like upgrading from a leaky tent to a sick mansion. Sometimes we can't wait to move out, and we get super frustrated with our current setup. Living here is like crashing in a bare-bones shack compared to what's coming. We're over it! God's given us a sneak peek of the real deal, our forever home, and these awesome new bodies. The Holy Spirit is like a trailer for the new life that gets us hyped for what's next. He's put a little bit of heaven in our hearts so we'll never settle for less.

That's why we're always in a good mood. You won't see us moping around or dragging our feet. The lame conditions here don't get us down because they just remind us of the epic life that's waiting for us. We're all in on what we can't see yet, and that's what keeps us going. You think a few bumps in the road are gonna stop us? No way. When it's time, we'll be totally ready to ditch this place and head home.

But it's not just about getting to heaven. The main thing is making God happy, no matter what's going on. Sooner or later, we're all gonna have to stand before God for a final review. We'll show up in front of Christ and get what we deserve for everything we've done, good or bad.

Knowing that keeps us on our toes, for real. It's a big deal to know that we'll all be in that judgment spot one day. That's why we're working like crazy to get everyone we meet ready to face God. Only God knows how well we're doing, but I hope you guys see how much we care. We're not just saying this to look good. We want you to be proud that we're on your team and not just being fake-nice to your face like so many people are. If I've been acting wild, it's for God. If I've been super serious, it's for you. Christ's love makes me do crazy things. His love is the boss of everything we do.

Our new mission is to live like this: one man died for everyone, so we're all in the same boat. He included everyone in his death so that we could all be part of his new life—a resurrection life that's way better than anything we could've managed on our own.

So now, we don't judge people by what they have or how they look. We used to look at the Messiah that way and got it all wrong. We're not making that mistake again. Now we look at what's inside, and we see that anyone who's with the Messiah gets an amazing change. They're a new creation. The old life is gone, and a new life has started! Look at it! This is all from God, who made things right between us and him, and then gave us the job of helping everyone else get right with each other. God put the world right with himself through the Messiah, giving everyone a fresh start by forgiving their sins. And now, he's given us the job of telling everyone what he's up to. We're like Christ's ambassadors. God uses us to convince people to drop their issues and join in on his work of making things right. We're speaking for Christ himself when we say: become friends with God; he's already friends with you.
How? It's all through Christ. God put all the wrong on him, who never did anything wrong, so that we could be made right with God. He took the fall for us so we could be put right with God.

title: Don't Team Up With Fakers
paragraphs: §Don't Be Mismatched

Hey, since we're on the same team doing God's work, we're begging you, don't let this awesome life God gave you go to waste. Seriously. God's basically saying, "I heard you when you called, and I had your back right when you needed it."

So listen up, now's the time to get with the program. Don't sleep on this. Don't make God's work harder by being late to the party or by questioning everything we're doing. People are watching to see if we're legit or not. They see us holding it down, staying focused, even when things get rough. We've been through it all: getting roughed up, thrown in jail, dealing with angry mobs, working crazy hours with no food. But we keep it real with pure hearts, clear minds, and steady hands. We're all about being gentle, holy, and showing honest love.
§Through Thick and Thin

We're out here speaking truth, and that's when God flexes his power. We're trying to make things right, whether people are cheering us on or hating on us. We get roasted and respected, but we stay true to our word even when people doubt us. The world might ghost us, but God sees us. They might say we're done, but we're more alive than ever. We've been beaten down but we're not giving up. We've cried a river, but we're still full of joy. We might be broke, but we're making a lot of people rich in spirit. We have nothing, but we have everything that matters.

For real, my Corinthian bros, I'm trying to tell you that you can have this big, awesome life too. We're not the ones holding you back. You're holding yourselves back. Your lives are meant to be huge, but you're living small. I'm just being straight with you because I care. Open up your lives! Live big!

And for real, don't team up with people who don't mess with God. How can you mix good and bad? That's not a team, that's a war. Can light and darkness be best friends? Does Jesus hang out with the Devil? Can you trust someone who doesn't trust in God? You wouldn't put a fake idol in God's temple, right? Well, you are God's temple. God lives in you. He said it himself:

"I'm gonna live in them, make my home in them. I'll be their God, and they'll be my crew. So bounce from all the fake stuff, for good," says God. "Don't hang with people who will just bring you down. I want you all for myself. I'll be your Father, and you'll be my sons and daughters." That's the word from the big boss, God himself.

title: The Ultimate Comeback
paragraphs: §Paul's Joy

Hey, with God promising us all this awesome stuff, we gotta ditch anything that messes with our lives, inside or out. Let's level up and make our lives a place where God would actually want to hang out.

Seriously, trust us. We've never scammed or taken advantage of anyone. I'm not trying to call you out. I've told you before, I'm your biggest fan, ride or die. I'm so proud of you guys it's not even funny. Even with all the drama we've been through, thinking about you just makes me happy.

When we first rolled into Macedonia, we were totally stressed. There was drama in the church, and we were panicking. We couldn't chill because we had no idea what was going to happen. But then God, who's the ultimate hype man for anyone feeling down, sent Titus to us, and it was a total game-changer. Just seeing him was cool, but the real W was hearing what he said about you guys: how you were all-in, how you felt bad about the situation, and how you had my back. I went from being a wreck to totally chill in like, five seconds.

Look, I know my last letter was harsh and probably made you feel terrible. I felt bad about it for a minute, but now I see it was for the best. It was a wake-up call. I'm not glad you were upset, but I'm stoked that it made you turn things around and get right with God. It was a total win.

Feeling bad in a way that pushes you toward God is a good thing. It's a powerful shift for your soul. You never regret that kind of pain. But when you let tough times push you away from God, you just end up with a life full of regrets, which is a major L.

And now, look at the comeback! That whole mess actually brought you closer to God. You're more alive, you care more, you're more respectful, and you're taking responsibility. From every angle, you guys came out of this looking like champs. That's what I wanted all along. I wasn't trying to start a beef or point fingers; I just wanted you to see how tight our crew is, with God at the center. And it worked! We were so stoked.

And when we saw how hyped Titus was about your response, our joy just doubled. He was so pumped by how you handled everything. I had been telling him how awesome you were, and you totally proved me right. He saw that I wasn't just gassing you up. Now he can't stop talking about how you guys stepped up and showed him major respect. He was totally blown away. And honestly, I couldn't be prouder. I'm so confident and proud of you.

title: The Ultimate Flex of Giving
paragraphs: §Generous Giving

Hey, check it out. I gotta tell you about the Macedonian churches. They've been going through some majorly tough times, like, seriously pushed to their limits. But it's in the middle of all that chaos that their true colors showed, and man, did they shine. They were super happy, even though they were broke. And here's the thing—the pressure made them do something totally unexpected. They started giving like crazy, just pure, generous hearts. I was there, I saw it. They gave everything they could, and then some, begging for the chance to help out other Christians who were struggling.

This wasn't some planned thing; it was all them. They totally caught us off guard. The secret? They gave themselves to God first, and then to us. The rest of the giving just flowed from that. That's why we hit up Titus to get you guys in on it, to finish what you started. You're already killing it in so many ways—you've got major faith, you're great with words, you're smart, you're passionate, and you love us. So, let's see you crush this, too.

I'm not trying to boss you around or anything. But seeing how hyped the Macedonians are, I'm hoping it'll light a fire under you and bring out your best. You already know how generous our main man, Jesus, was. He was loaded, but he gave it all up for us. In one move, he became poor so we could become rich. That's the ultimate sacrifice.

So here's the deal: finish what you started last year. Don't let those positive energy go stale. Your hearts were in the right place from the jump. You've got this, so get it done. Once you're committed, you do what you can, not what you can't. Your heart's in charge of your hands. This isn't about you sweating while everyone else chills. Nah, you're in this together. Your extra can cover their empty, and their extra can cover your empty. It all evens out. Like it says in the book, "The one with the most didn't have too much, and the one with the least wasn't left out."

I'm so thankful that God gave Titus the same level of care for you that I have. He was super cool about how we felt, but he's also really stoked to come and help you with this offering. We're sending another guy with him, a distinguished leader in the churches for how he preaches the message. But he's more than just popular; he's solid. The churches handpicked him to roll with us on this mission, to share God's gifts and make sure everything is on the up and up. We're being extra careful to not even look like we're skimming off the top. We're keeping it 100 with both God and people.
That's why we're also sending another trusted friend. This guy is legit dependable and has been from day one. He's heard awesome things about you and is pumped to meet you.

I don't even need to hype up Titus. We've been a team for a long time, serving you guys. The bros traveling with him are sent by the churches, a total credit to Christ. So show them what you're made of. Show them that love I've been bragging about to the other churches. Let them see it for themselves!

title: The Generosity Challenge
paragraphs: §Cheerful Givers

Alright, so I feel like a broken record talking about this donation for the other believers, but I gotta say, I know you guys are all in. I've been hyping you up to everyone in Macedonia, telling them you've been ready to roll since last year. Your energy is totally contagious and has gotten almost everyone else pumped up too.

So, I'm sending my crew ahead to make sure you're actually ready like I said. I don't want to look like I was just talking trash. It would be super embarrassing for all of us if I showed up with some of the Macedonian crew and you guys weren't prepared. That's why I'm sending these guys as helpers to get everything sorted out before I arrive. I want this to be a gift you're excited to give, not something you feel pressured into at the last second.

Here's the deal: if you're stingy, you'll get a stingy outcome. But if you're generous, you'll get a massive return. I want you to really think about it and decide for yourselves what you want to give. Don't let anyone guilt-trip you into it. God loves it when you're stoked to give.

And check this out: God can totally shower you with blessings in the most insane ways, so you'll have more than enough of everything you need and then some to spare. It's like the old saying: 'He's super generous to those in need, and his good deeds will be remembered forever.' The same God who hooks up farmers with seeds that turn into food is going to be over-the-top generous with you. He'll give you tons of resources so you can be generous to others, and that will make everyone praise God.

Doing this isn't just about helping people out with their basic needs. It's way bigger than that. It makes people super thankful to God. When you're generous, it shows you're legit about following Jesus. Your generosity is a huge thank you to God, and it helps out not just your friends but everyone. And because God has been so awesome to you, they'll be praying for you and have your back. Seriously, thank God for this incredible gift. There are no words for how amazing it is!

title: Paul Claps Back
paragraphs: §Paul Defends His Ministry

Alright, let's get real for a sec. I'm writing this with the same chill but serious vibe that Jesus has. I've been hearing some rumors that I'm a total pushover when I'm with you guys, but then I act all tough in my letters. Seriously? Don't make me come over there and get all intense. I won't think twice about calling out anyone who says I'm just some fake. They'll be eating their words, for real.

Look, the world is a mess. It's a total free-for-all, and nobody plays fair. But that's not how we roll. We've got a different way of doing things. Our gear isn't for getting likes or tricking people. It's for wrecking the whole corrupt system. We've got these epic God-tools that smash messed-up ideas and tear down anything that gets in the way of God's truth. We take every wild thought and feeling and make it line up with how Christ wants us to live. We're always ready to clear out the junk and help people level up in their faith.

You guys are staring so hard at what's right in front of you that you're missing the big picture. If you want to see someone who's on Team Jesus, why are you ghosting me? Trust me, I know where I stand with Christ. You might think I'm flexing with the power He gave me, but I'm not backing down. Everything I do is to help you guys grow, not to tear you down.

And what's all this chatter about me being brave only in letters? I hear you're saying, "His letters are all talk, but in person, he's a total weakling who can't even speak up." That's some serious trash talk, but it's not gonna stick. What I write is what I'll do when I'm there. I'm the same guy, whether I'm with you or just sending a message.

Just to be clear, we're not trying to get into a popularity contest with those guys who think they're so much better than us. We're not about that life. They're so busy comparing and ranking themselves that they're totally missing the point.

We're not making crazy claims here. We're just sticking to the job God gave us, and that job includes you. We're not trying to steal anyone's thunder. We were the first ones to bring you the good news about Jesus, right? So there's no question that we're supposed to be here.

We're not trying to crash someone else's party and take credit for their work. We're hoping that as your faith gets stronger, you'll help us do even more. We'll keep spreading the message to other places, but we're not going to take credit for what other people have already done. If you're going to brag, brag about what God has done. It doesn't matter what you say about yourself. It's what God says about you that really counts.

title: Paul’s Flex and the Fake Preachers
paragraphs: §Paul's Sufferings

Hey, can you guys just bear with me for a sec? I know I might sound a little crazy, but I gotta get this off my chest. I’m super passionate about you guys—like, God-level passionate. I set you up to be with Christ, like a perfect match. But now I’m worried you’re getting played, just like Eve got totally tricked by that smooth-talking snake. I’m scared you’re losing that pure and simple love you had for Christ.

It’s wild because if some random guy shows up talking about a totally different Jesus, a different vibe, a different message, you’re all just cool with it. You tolerate these so-called “important apostles,” so why can’t you handle me? I’m just as legit as they are. Sure, I might not have the slickest voice or the fancy words that blow you away, but when I speak, I actually know my stuff. We’ve been 100% real with you from the start.

Did I mess up by giving you God’s message for free? I didn’t want to be a burden. Other churches were covering my expenses so you guys could get the message without paying. While I was with you, I never asked for a thing. The crew from Macedonia always had my back. I made sure I wasn’t a hassle, and I never will be. I swear on Christ, that’s my promise. And I’m not gonna be quiet about it just because of what people might say. It’s not that I don’t love you—God knows I do. I’m just trying to keep it real between us.

And I’m not backing down. I’d rather die than take your cash. I’m not giving anyone a reason to group me with those money-hungry preachers who act like they’re all that. They’re a total joke—fake apostles, lying preachers, and crooked workers pretending to be on Christ’s team, but they’re phonies. And honestly, it’s not a shocker. Satan himself pretends to be an angel of light. So it’s no surprise his followers try to look like servants of God. But they won’t get away with it. They’ll get what’s coming to them.

Let me get back to my point, and don’t get mad if I keep sounding a little nuts. Or just go with it and let me rant. I didn’t get this talk from Christ; I picked it up from all the show-off preachers you guys seem to love. Since you’re all so good at putting up with fakes who steal your freedom, rip you off, and even disrespect you to your face, you can handle a little foolishness from me. I gotta admit, we’re not built to handle that kind of drama.

Since you’re so into these arrogant preachers, let me try to play their game for a second. They brag about their heritage? I’m right there with them. They say they’re servants of Christ? I’m way ahead of them. (I can’t believe I’m even saying this—it’s insane, but I’m gonna finish what I started).

I’ve put in way more work, been in jail more times than I can count, and almost died over and over. I’ve been whipped five times, beaten with rods three times, and stoned once. I’ve been shipwrecked three times and spent a whole day and night lost at sea. I’ve been through rough travels, dodged robbers, and dealt with enemies from all sides. I’ve faced danger in cities and in the middle of nowhere, from the desert heat to ocean storms, and even got betrayed by people I thought were my friends. I’ve been through it all—hard work, sleepless nights, hunger, cold, and being left with nothing.

And that’s not even the half of it. I’ve got the daily stress of worrying about all the churches. When someone’s at their breaking point, I feel it in my soul. When someone gets tricked into sin, I get fired up.

If I’m going to brag, I’ll brag about the things that make me humble, the things that make me more like Jesus. God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I’m not lying. Remember that time in Damascus when the governor’s guards were out to get me? I had to climb out a window, get lowered in a basket, and run for my life. Now that’s a story.

title: My Weakness is My Superpower
paragraphs: §Paul's Vision and Thorn

You guys are really making me do this, and honestly, it feels a bit weird to brag. But since you're pushing me, I'll tell you about some insane visions and secret info God gave me. Like, I know this guy who, fourteen years ago, got totally snatched up by Christ and went to the highest level of heaven. No clue if he was actually there in person or just his spirit, only God knows that. This same guy got taken up to paradise. Again, no idea if it was a physical trip or a spiritual one. God's the only one with the deets. He heard some top-secret stuff, but was told to keep it on the down-low. That's the guy I'm willing to talk about. But me? I'm not going to say anything about myself, except for the stuff that makes me look weak.

Look, if I really wanted to flex, I could. And I wouldn't even be lying. But I'll spare you the cringey bragging. I don't want you to think I'm some big shot. I'm just a regular guy, the same guy you'd see on the street.

Because of all the crazy things I saw, and to make sure I didn't get a huge ego, I was given this major weakness to remind me I'm not perfect. It was like Satan's own messenger was sent to take me down. But instead of crushing me, it just made me pray harder. So there was no chance of me getting arrogant. At first, I totally hated it and begged God to take it away. I asked him three times, and then he told me, 'My grace is all you need. My power works best when you're weak.'

Once I heard that, I was actually cool with it. I stopped stressing about my weakness and started seeing it as a gift. It was like Christ's power was having an incredible impact in my life. Now, I'm cool with my limitations, the hate, the tough times, and all the bad breaks. I just let Christ take the wheel. So, the weaker I am, the stronger I get.

So yeah, I've made myself sound like a total fool. But you guys made me do it! You should have been the ones hyping me up, not making me do it myself. You know that even though I'm a nobody, I'm not a second-rate apostle compared to those other guys you're so obsessed with. You saw the signs of a true apostle when I was with you—the miracles, the wonders, the power. Were you treated worse than any other church? The only thing you got less of was financial responsibility for me. My bad. Forgive me for not taking your money.

I'm all set to visit you for the third time, and don't worry, I won't be a burden. I'm not after your money; I'm after you. Kids aren't supposed to provide for their parents; it's the other way around. I'd gladly spend everything I have, even my own life, for you. So why is it that the more I love you, the less you love me back?

And what's with all the rumors that I'm secretly scamming you? Where's the proof? Did I ever rip you off through any of the guys I sent to you? I asked Titus to visit, and he brought some other guys with him. Did they take anything from you? Haven't we always been totally honest with you?

I hope you don't think we're just trying to defend ourselves to you. You're not the judge here; God is. We're making our case to him. We've gone to all this trouble to support ourselves so we wouldn't get in the way of your growth.

I'll admit, I'm worried that when I come, you'll let me down, and I'll let you down. I'm scared that we'll get into a huge fight and everything will fall apart—arguments, jealousy, anger, taking sides, trash talk, and all-around chaos. I really don't want to be humiliated by God in front of you again, crying over the people who keep sinning and refuse to leave their messy lives behind.

title: Final Warning, Seriously
paragraphs: §Examine Yourselves

Alright, listen up. This is my third time coming to see you guys. You know how they say "two or three witnesses make it legit"? Well, consider this your final warning. Last time I was here, I told that crew who kept messing up that I wouldn't go easy on them next time. So, I'm telling you again before I even get there: get your act together, or you're gonna face the music.

For all of you who've been asking for "proof" that Christ is speaking through me, you're about to get it, big time. You're gonna get the full power of Christ, seriously. When he was on the cross, he looked weak and got totally humiliated. But now? He's alive and flexes God's crazy power. We might have looked like a bunch of nobodies when we were with you, but next time you see us, we'll be glowing up in Christ with God's strength.

So, check yourselves before you wreck yourselves. Make sure your faith is solid. Don't just coast along, assuming everything's cool. You need to see for yourselves, not just hear rumors, that Jesus is actually in you. Put it to the test. If you're failing, then you gotta do something about it. I'm hoping we pass the test, but honestly, I'd rather we failed and you guys passed. We're on your team, for real. We're cheering for you to get it right.
§Final Warnings
We don't just deal with our weaknesses, we own them. And then we celebrate every time you guys level up in the truth. We're praying hard that everything clicks for you.

I'm writing this now so I don't have to waste time roasting you when I get there. The power the big guy upstairs gave me is for building people up, not tearing them down. I'm ready to get to the good stuff, not just hand out detentions.

So yeah, that's pretty much it. Stay positive. Keep it real. Work together. Be cool with each other. Do all that, and the God of love and peace will have your back, for sure. Give each other a bro-hug. All the homies here say 'sup.
May the awesome grace of the main man, Jesus Christ, the epic love of God, and the super-close friendship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.
